title: Two or more openings.
officialText:
Where two or more openings are provided into one chimney flue or vent, the openings shall
be at different levels, or the connectors shall be attached to the vertical portion of the chimney or vent at an angle of 45 degrees
(0.79 rad) or less relative to the vertical.
